'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee constructed tournament in Texas, 19–21 April 2013, played in the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.3]] pool.<ref name="tdl">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ starwarsccg.org], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020044435/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive].</ref> Its Day 1 decklists were published as a PDF on the Players Committee decklist desk; the sheets are dated 20 April 2013.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.3]]
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 19–21 April 2013
* '''Winner:'''
